## Before review

- [ ] A test for what runs off an appliance, in `tools/test-*.py` with its step in `checks.yml`; for a driver, the lab script that ran
- [ ] A new or changed string on a page - a menu entry, a label, a new page - is named here; its Arabic may follow later
- [ ] No addresses, MAC addresses, serial numbers or host names - in the text, the logs or the photographs
- [ ] I agree to the terms in CONTRIBUTING.md, "Copyright, and what a contribution agrees to"
